main_text.p: tantum extra vilissimam plebem sumus, ubique in patria, sumus. Denique in ipsis exterorum linguis, nescio quo contagio, eorundem vitia sunt: Alia loquax, alia falax, alia in supervacaneas cæremonias pomposa, alia in serviles Principum adulationes projecta: Candidus his, ô Belgæ, quia colorem facile bibit, inquinatur animus.
main_text.head: Quæstio XII.

head.i: An inter amicos conveniat Nova, quæ Remp. concernunt, narrare?

main_text.p: HOdiernis moribus opportunè decretum est, ut à bonis malisvè Novis, in familiaribus colloquiis ducatur exordium : Nam & ea

page.notes: The drop cap H is a large woodcut-style initial joined to "Odiernis". The heading "Quæstio XII." is set in large roman type and the question below in italic, both centred. The Quæstio heading is treated as a part (level 2) inside the work. Show-through from the facing page is ignored.
